definitions: A thing, especially a trend or fact, that indicates the state or level of something.
A device for showing the state or level of something.
A signal light on a road vehicle that flashes to show that the driver intends to turn left or right.
A substance that changes colour to show the presence or absence of a particular substance, or the degree of acidity or alkalinity.
A person or thing that indicates.
examples: Car ownership is frequently used as an indicator of affluence.
The fuel indicator was on empty.
He put his indicator on and turned right.
The compass needle is an indicator of magnetic north.
